title: Open Values Non-Brand Values v1
description: A list of words found in the brand field of options that are not brands, such as "generic" or "private messenger". The site's build uses it so it does not treat them as companies. Conscious Consuming keeps it.

format.description: Always "ovs-non-brand-values". Tells a reader that this file lists brand-field text that is not a brand.

version.description: The version of this file's format, as major.minor.patch starting with 1.

updated.description: The day the file was last changed, as YYYY-MM-DD.

groups.description: The values, sorted into named groups such as "placeholders" or "kinds of software and service". Each value is compared with an entry's brand text after both are lower-cased, with accents removed, "&" read as "and", apostrophes dropped and other punctuation read as a space.
